priorities.summary: An output-encoding flaw in the JSON RPC API of FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer lets an unauthenticated attacker execute unauthorized code or commands via a specially crafted HTTP request when the JSON API is enabled. Fortinet's November advisories cover the 7.6 and 8.0 lines — patch now, or apply workarounds where a fix is still upcoming.
priorities.plain: FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer let an attacker on the network run code on the device without logging in; patch or apply Fortinet's workaround now.

priorities.summary: A SQL injection flaw in FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer lets an unauthenticated attacker who can reach the OFTP port run code or commands on the system via crafted OFTP packets. Fortinet's November advisories cover affected 7.2 through 8.0 releases — upgrade to a fixed version.
priorities.plain: FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer let an attacker on the network run commands on the device without logging in; upgrade to a fixed version now.

priorities.summary: A deserialization flaw in Puppet's report-processing code lets a client holding any CA-signed agent certificate run arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as its service user. CISA added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 18 November citing active exploitation — upgrade Puppet Core to 8.22.2 or 9.1.3, or Puppet Enterprise to a fixed release.
priorities.plain: Puppet lets an attacker with a signed agent certificate run code on the central server; upgrade Puppet now, and check certificate signing.

model.name: Gemini 4 Neon
model.summary: Google's fourth Gemini 4 model, pitched as frontier-level intelligence for complex software engineering, knowledge work and science at faster, lower-cost speeds than its largest models. Rolling out now to AI Pro and Ultra subscribers and through the Gemini API and AI Studio.
model.plain: A faster frontier AI model for coding, analysis and research work that businesses can put straight into everyday workflows.
